Day by day, 2026-11-01 – 2026-11-23: transits, every rule and every analysis – checked against the markets

US Eastern dates; sidereal Lahiri, mean node, whole-sign drishti. Probabilities come from the combined model (all layers, fitted on 2000 – 2026-10-31); green / red = 2+ points above / below the market's base rate. Over 2013–2026 that model was right 51–55% of the time: read the probabilities as leanings, not certainties. Rules count as supported when their 26-year status is Strongest, Supported or Consistent. Market prices and astrology only.

How it did: share of calls that matched the market

A call is a bullish or bearish reading; it is right when the market moved that way the same day (close to close) or over the next 5 sessions (from the previous close). Days with no reading are not counted. Compare each figure with how often the market rose in the period: a method that always says 'down' scores the down share. The combined model's weights were fitted on data up to 2026-10-31 only.
